results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: The commentary says "Federal & State Taxes (6-month average 999) and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous (6-month average 721) are zero in Jun 2026". The nonzero averages show these were nonzero before, and it names two of the listed lines.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: The commentary gives 999 for Federal & State Taxes (true 998.5083, about 0.05% off) and 721 for Marketing Misc (true 721.0033, about 0.0005% off). Both are within 5%, and the 2,500 and 3,773 figures are last-nonzero values, not prior averages.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: No cause is stated as fact. The commentary only says "Whether any of these has stopped for good or is timing is for the reviewer to confirm."

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: The lines are not called discontinued or cancelled. The commentary leaves "stopped for good or is timing" to the reviewer.
